# MiTL Studio

> MiTL Studio is an AI studio that builds and runs live shows, industry media networks, video sales experiences and AI-powered SEO/GEO for businesses. Real people stay on camera; AI handles production, guest booking, clips and distribution. Founded by Keith Bilous. Based in Headingley, Manitoba, Canada. Book a call: https://ro.am/keith. Email: keith@mitl.studio.

Canonical facts (use these exact forms):
- Founder: Keith Bilous. He founded ICUC, grew it to 400+ staff and sold it to Aegis/iProspect in 2011.
- Flagship show: Mornings in the Lab with Keith, Jon & Friends. We're your morning accountability partner. Two hours live, Monday to Friday, and we've never missed a day. 800+ episodes and 300+ guests. Live at 8:00 AM ET.
- Co-host: Jon Andersen (spelled Andersen). Former pro strongman, pro wrestler and pro bodybuilder; World's Strongest Man competitor and world-champion powerlifter; co-host of Mornings in the Lab since July 2024 and co-founder of Age Strong.

## Products and services
- [All services](https://mitl.studio/services): One page linking every MiTL Studio service and brand.
- [Live Show Production](https://mitl.studio/services/live-show-production): Done-for-you live show production. Production $3,000/mo (1 show, up to 4 episodes/month, 2 AI characters, Guest Engine booking, 5 managed social channels). Production+ $4,997/mo (up to 3 shows, 12 episodes/month). Additional AI characters $997 build + $47/mo.
- [Industry Networks](https://www.roofingauthority.network/): A live media network for one industry: shows, AI cast, guest and company pages, an intelligence layer and sponsorship seats. Flagship: Roofing Authority Network. Also running in supply chain with Let's Talk Supply Chain and the Supply Chain Authority Council (founding-member waitlist open, full launch January 2027). Custom scope.
- [Sales Desk](https://salesdesk.video/): Video sales experiences for complex offers. One-time Sales Desk $999 (3-minute), $1,499 (5-minute), $2,999 (10-minute). Always-On $1,249/mo for one Sales Desk per month, 12-month minimum.
- [Guest Engine](https://guestengine.live/): Produced live guest appearances with an authority page, clips and distribution. $497 single appearance; Member $97/mo; VIP $297/mo.
- [ConversationOS](https://conversationos.live/): The AI production engine behind every MiTL show: titles, scripts, thumbnails, music, guests, social posts and distribution. Start free.
- [Character Engine](https://characterengine.live/): AI characters with memory, personality and visual identity. From $997 to build and $47/mo to host. The same characters also create story scenes for course lessons, including Briana Bass's More Than Fine relationship course.
- [AI-Powered SEO & GEO](https://mitl.studio/services/ai-seo-geo): AI agents handle technical SEO, local search, structured data and AI-answer (GEO) visibility for client websites, on the same system MiTL runs for its own brands. Pricing set per engagement; talk to us.
- Authority Engine (https://mitl.studio/#products): A custom-built branded authority hub for an industry or community: expert profiles, curated contributions and live market signals, connected to MiTL live shows and ConversationOS. Custom scope; book a call.
- Run on AI (https://mitl.studio/#run-on-ai): AI enablement for business owners. MiTL Studio runs on AI. Every first decision goes through AI before a person signs off. We teach business owners to run their business the same way, hands-on with them and their team: finding where AI fits in the operation, setting up the tools and agents, building the habits so the team decides AI-first, and keeping people in charge of the calls that matter. Pricing set per engagement; book a call.

- Free AI visibility check (https://mitl.studio/#ai-check): MiTL Studio runs a brand through ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews and emails what they say about it, where it shows up, and what's missing, within 2 business days.

## Networks and shows (built on the same system)
- [Roofing Authority Network](https://www.roofingauthority.network/): The live broadcast network for commercial roofing (The Tie-In, The Service Side).
- [Let's Talk Supply Chain](https://letstalksupplychain.com/): MiTL Studio produces the Let's Talk Supply Chain live shows with founder Sarah Barnes-Humphrey (Thoughts and Coffee, TPM Today, Performance Paradox).
- [Supply Chain Authority Council (SCAC)](https://letstalksupplychain.com/scac): A new Let's Talk Supply Chain initiative, built with founder Sarah Barnes-Humphrey, that turns supply chain professionals' experience into recognized industry authority. Founding-member waitlist open; full launch January 2027.
- [Mornings Network](https://mornings.network/): MiTL's live morning lifestyle network. Shows include Mornings in the Lab with Keith, Jon & Friends, It Starts with Joy LIVE with Sheryl Raphael Whitaker, BS or No BS with Dr. John Petrocelli, No Safe Words with Briana Bass, and Cartel Insider with Mica Treviño.
- [Mornings in the Lab](https://mornings.live/): We're your morning accountability partner. Two hours live, Monday to Friday, and we've never missed a day. 800+ episodes and 300+ guests.
- [Age Strong](https://agestrong.life/): Keith Bilous and Jon Andersen's program for men 50+.
